decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and numbered 841_01_01, 841_01_02, 841_01_03, 841_01_04, 841_01_05, 841_01_11, 841_01_12, 841_01_13A, 841_01_14, 841_02_01, 841_02_11, 841_03_01, 841_03_02, 841_03_03, 841_03_04, 841_03_11, 841_03_12, 841_03_13A, 841_03_14, 841_12_01A, 841_13_01aA, 841_13_01bA, 841_13_02aA, 841_13_02bA, 841_13_02_01AA, 841_13_02_01bA, 841_13_03_02A, 841_13_04aA, 841_13_04bA, 841_11_01, 841_11_02aA, 841_11_02bA, 841_11_03, 841_11_04, 841_11_05, Arboricultural Impact Assessment Report (FND/BWG/A1A/01),All received 4 April 2011and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building is occupied).

Condition : 3 - In this condition "retained tree" means an existing tree which is to be retained in accordance with the approved plans and particulars as detailed in the Arboricultural Impact Statement submitted by Landmark Trees (AIS). (a)	No retained tree shall be cut down, uprooted or destroyed, nor shall any retained tree be topped or lopped other than in accordance with the approved plans and particulars, without the written approval of the local planning authority.  Any topping or lopping approved shall be carried out in accordance with British Standard [3998 (Tree Work)] or any other BS replacing.(b)	If any retained tree is removed, uprooted or destroyed or dies, another tree shall be planted at the same place and that tree shall be of such size and species, and shall be planted at such time, as may be specified in writing by the local planning authority.(c) No development shall take place and no equipment, machiney or materials shall be brought onto the site for the purposes of the development or demolition works until (a) precise details and a specification of the fencing for the protection of any retained tree has been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority; and (b) the erection of protective fencing has been undertaken in accordance with the approved details. The fencing shall be retained until all equipment, machinery and surplus materials have been removed from the site. (d)	Nothing shall be stored or placed in any area fenced-off in accordance with this condition, or under the canopy of any tree to be retained, and the ground levels within those areas shall not be altered without the written approval of the local planning authority.

Condition : 4 - No demolition of construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8am to 6pm on Mondays to Friday and 8am to 12pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The 'sedum roof' hereby approved shall be implemented during the first planting season after first occupation of the development. Any plants that are planted in accordance with this condition which are removed, die, become severely damaged or seriously diseased within five years of planting shall be replaced within the next planting season by others of similar size and species, and the sedum roof shall thereafter be retained at all times with living plants.

Condition : 6 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extensions hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.
description: Demolition of the existing rear and side extension and construction of a new rear and side extension.
